findings.subject: CLI deadline not forwarded
findings.repair: Forward deadline to plan/document/review; do not cap only the first phase.

findings.subject: Recoverable structure refusal terminates iteration
findings.repair: Separate recoverable structural or semantic repair from provider/input/deadline terminal failure; preserve original AI review.

findings.subject: Logical table document coverage is not represented
findings.repair: AI entity inventory and coverage, one discovered logical/physical table per document; no fixed business names or counts.

findings.subject: Reports share specification output root
findings.repair: Typed artifact role and output routing separate from AI business granularity.

findings.subject: Source-read closure is self-reported
findings.repair: Record required materials, read receipts, unresolved closure and fact basis with versioned evidence.

findings.subject: Disconnected helper warning lacks structured provenance
findings.repair: Represent entry/caller/registration/evidence and confirmed/declaration-only/unknown-within-scope status without helper-name rules.

findings.subject: No plan repair or stable split/merge lineage
findings.repair: AI plan assessment and immutable repaired plan with entity coverage and ID lineage.

findings.subject: Batch pre-task or future error may lose summary
findings.repair: Capture errors into immutable batch results; distinguish selected subset from project-wide completion.

findings.subject: Reference-root resolve hides links and protected root is not rejected
findings.repair: Check source/reference ancestors before resolve; refuse evaluator-only roots and nested links/reparse points without changing live capsules.

positiveBoundaries: Raw and indexed material is lossless
Document sourcePaths is a starting set rather than a closure cap
Basis separates reference intent from observed code
Structural approval cannot be replaced by AI approval
Immutable draft/review hashes and per-phase snapshot guards
Iteration preserves previous draft and critique without Python rewriting
